performance.verdict: Six overdue milestones and a zero-call GBP profile stall the scale-up gate.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Booking bot battle-test, due 2026-07-31); intake owner still unconfirmed, blocking all budget scale-up per engagement plan.
LSA re-enable (heating toggles) was due 2026-09-01 — 13 days overdue; no LSA spend visible in series, meaning heating-season demand window is eroding daily.
28-day CPL is $232.05 on only 7 tracked paid leads; 3-day spend (Sep 11–13) averages $36.59/day vs prior 3-day (Sep 8–10) $53.04 — efficiency looks better but volume is near zero.
Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP: 206 impressions over 25 days, 0 calls, 0 directions — a 0.0% call rate against a live profile is a confirmed engagement failure.
GHL shows 677 opportunities created vs 43 won (6.4% win rate) across 264 contacts; 0 appointments logged — leads arriving but no appointment capture suggests intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat assignment — unblocks scale-up gate per SOW; no budget moves until resolved.
